# agentgateway_llm_api_keys (Data Source)

Virtual API key metadata, sorted by id. Key material is never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Virtual API key metadata. The data source never returns key material.
data "agentgateway_llm_api_keys" "all" {}

output "key_owners" {
  value = [
    for key in data.agentgateway_llm_api_keys.all.keys : {
      name  = key.name
      user  = key.user
      group = key.group
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only include keys whose id (a server-generated UUID) starts with this prefix.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity of the listing: `llm.apiKey:<name_prefix>`.
- `keys` (Attributes List) Virtual API key metadata stored by the gateway, sorted by id. Key material is never returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_models` (List of String) Model patterns the key may request. Null means unconstrained; an empty list denies every model.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time in RFC3339 format. Null when the gateway did not report a parseable timestamp.
- `group` (String) Owning group from `metadata.group`.
- `id` (String) Server-generated key id.
- `name` (String) Key name from `metadata.name`, or the key id when the key carries no name.
- `user` (String) Owning user from `metadata.user`.
